questions.subject: Quantitative Aptitude
questions.question: A can complete a work in 10 days and B can complete the same work in 15 days. In how many days can they complete it working together?
questions.explanation: A's 1 day work = 1/10, B's 1 day work = 1/15. Combined = 1/10 + 1/15 = 3/30 + 2/30 = 5/30 = 1/6. So they complete it in 6 days.

questions.subject: Quantitative Aptitude
questions.question: If A:B = 3:4 and B:C = 6:7, then A:B:C is:
questions.explanation: A:B = 3:4, B:C = 6:7. To combine, make B equal: A:B = 9:12, B:C = 12:14. So A:B:C = 9:12:14

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: If APPLE is coded as BQQMF, how is MANGO coded?
questions.explanation: Each letter is replaced by the next letter in the alphabet. M→N, A→B, N→O, G→H, O→P. So MANGO = NBOHP

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: If A is the son of B, and B is the sister of C, then how is A related to C?
questions.explanation: B is C's sister. A is B's son. Therefore A is C's nephew.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: Rajesh walks 10 km north, then turns right and walks 5 km, then turns right and walks 10 km. In which direction is he from the starting point?
questions.explanation: He walks north 10km, then east 5km, then south 10km. He is 5km east of the start. So he is to the East.

questions.question: In a class of 100 students, 60 play cricket, 50 play football, and 20 play both. How many students play neither?
questions.explanation: Students playing at least one sport = 60 + 50 - 20 = 90. Neither = 100 - 90 = 10.
